summary: Iteration 80 backend-only regression + 4 new features (Point 49 b/c/d + 49-a variants retry). All 14 pytest cases pass. (1) Streaming endpoint /api/bills/{id}/image/stream: rejects unauth with 403; returns 200 image/jpeg with non-empty body for TEST-OBJSTORE-01 with admin JWT; returns 404 for unknown bill_id. Legacy /api/bills/{id}/image JSON endpoint still 200 (backward compat). (2) brand_in_mirror flag verified on both /api/bills and /api/bills/pending-review — every returned bill has boolean field; seeded brand 'TEST_BrandAuditX' (category=Dining) produces brand_in_mirror=true, unknown store_name produces false. (3) /api/admin/bills/brand-audit returns proper shape {total_scanned, total_missing, bills[]}; seeded brand does NOT appear in missing list. (4) _reprocess_single_bill brand variants retry: verified with patched earn_points (reject original 'sagar ratna' + Title Case, accept UPPER 'SAGAR RATNA') that earn_points is called with UPPER variant and bill.store_name is persisted as UPPER. (5) push_bill_to_fundle happy path (in-process with patched earn_points→120): response.success=true, fundle_points=120, delta_points=70; user's balance_points and total_earned_points grew by +70; bill.force_credited=false; bill.fundle_pushed_at set; bill.points_issued=120. (6) push-to-fundle failure (earn_points returns 0): response.success=false, bill unchanged (still force_credited, no fundle_pushed_at). (7) push-to-fundle guards via HTTP: non-force-credited → 400, already-pushed → 400, unknown bill_id → 404. (8) Regression: admin /admin/me, /admin/users, /api/bills, and consumer /home, /wallet, /profile, /tier-info all 200.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py: `_brand_in_mirror`, `_brand_names_norm`, and `_BRAND_MIRROR_CACHE` are DEFINED THREE TIMES (L2953, L3128, L3157 for the function; L3136 for the cache), a copy/paste duplication across three consecutive blocks. Python silently accepts the last definition, but this is a code-hygiene smell that will bite whoever tries to tweak the cache TTL or normalisation rules (they'll change one copy and wonder why nothing budges). Consolidate to a single definition near L2940.

push_bill_to_fundle (L3269) always logs `processed_by='admin_push_to_fundle'` but on the failure branch it returns immediately without recording that a push was attempted — no `last_push_attempt_at` or `last_push_error` field is written to the bill. Repeated failed push attempts leave no trail; admins re-clicking the button get no cue that Fundle keeps rejecting. Consider persisting the last attempt timestamp+error on failure.

push_bill_to_fundle re-issues the local balance delta only when delta!=0 (L3323). If Fundle returns EXACTLY the same points already force-credited (e.g. 50→50), the bill flips force_credited=false and marks fundle_pushed_at but the user's balance stays put — correct math, but there's no user notification/log line that the push landed. Minor UX consideration for admin flow.

The 49-a brand-variants loop only breaks on non-brand errors when the error string contains 'brand', 'match', 'not found', or '0 points' (L4503). If Fundle changes its error phrasing (e.g. 'unknown store'), the loop will burn extra retries. A reject_reason-code check on the Fundle response would be more robust than substring matching.

stream_bill_image logs the Karix Authorization header via `KARIX_API_KEY` — no leak, but note this fetches `raw.startswith('http')` images with Bearer auth even for non-Karix hosts. Tighten hostname check before attaching auth.
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped fixture creates brand 'TEST_BrandAuditX' (category=Dining, atv=500) via POST /api/admin/brands and tears down. Per-test ephemeral bills (TEST-VAR-*, TEST-PUSH-*, TEST-PUSHF-*, TEST-PUSHG-*, TEST-MIRROR-*) inserted directly into MongoDB and cleaned up in finally-block. User 9876543210 balance/total_earned adjustments made by push-to-fundle happy path are reverted in cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration80_point49bcd.py has method-level tests that reset motor's `server.db` handle before each asyncio.run (helper `_reset_motor_client()`) — required because motor's AsyncIOMotorClient is loop-bound and would fail with 'Event loop is closed' otherwise. Reuse this pattern for future in-process tests. Push-to-Fundle happy path must be tested IN-PROCESS (not via HTTP) because unittest.mock.patch on the local tagnpay_client instance does NOT propagate to the running backend service (separate Python process). Use `await server.push_bill_to_fundle(bill_id, payload={'username': 'admin'})` directly. The stream endpoint uses `Response` (not StreamingResponse) so full body arrives in one chunk — acceptable for typical bill images <5MB but consider StreamingResponse for very large legacy images.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new bugs found. All four features (image/stream, brand-audit, brand_in_mirror flag, push-to-fundle, brand-variants retry) verified working as specified. Duplicate function definitions in server.py flagged as code-hygiene issue but do not affect behaviour.
